newsitem.title: ITALY: SAF approve increase to Florence airport capital.
newsitem.headline: SAF approve increase to Florence airport capital.

text.p: Florence airport's management company Societa Aeroporto Fiorentino (SAF) said it has approved a capital increase to eight billion lira from five billion lira.
SAF chairman Riccardo Bicchi said the increase underlines the airport's aim to improve service quality by making the necessary investments.
These include expanded check-in facilities,as well as the separation of incoming EU and non-EU traffic in order to meet the requirements of the Schenengen agreement, the airport added.
Improved sound reduction barriers will be installed around aircraft parking areas, they said said.

They added that the largest aircraft now able to use the airport are British Aerospace Plc 146-200 planes and there are no plans to extend the airport's 1,650 metre runway. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
